user.title: Hebcal Jewish Calendar - Language Selection
user.description: Choose your preferred language for event names and calendar information.

data_description.language: Select the language for displaying Jewish calendar events and holiday names

location.title: Hebcal Jewish Calendar - Location Setup
location.description: Configure your geographic location for accurate Jewish calendar calculations including Shabbat times, holidays, and halachic times (Zmanim).

data_description.latitude: Your location's latitude coordinate (-90 to 90 degrees)
data_description.longitude: Your location's longitude coordinate (-180 to 180 degrees)
data_description.time_zone: Your local time zone (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London, Asia/Jerusalem)

settings.title: Hebcal Jewish Calendar - Advanced Settings
settings.description: Configure additional settings for Jewish calendar calculations and display preferences.

data_description.havdalah_minutes: Minutes after sunset for Havdalah. Common customs: 42 (Geonim), 50 (Jerusalem), 72 (Rabbeinu Tam).
data_description.time_before_check: Buffer in minutes to activate sensors before Shabbat/Holiday entrance.
data_description.time_after_check: Buffer in minutes to keep sensors active after Shabbat/Holiday end.
data_description.jerusalem_candle: Enable to use the Jerusalem custom of lighting candles 40 minutes before sunset (instead of 18).
data_description.tzeit_hakochavim: Use astronomical star emergence time for Havdalah timing, instead of a fixed number of minutes after sunset.
data_description.diaspora: Enable this if you are outside of Israel (Diaspora). This will calculate holidays as two days long.
data_description.use_12h_time: Display times in 12-hour format with AM/PM instead of 24-hour format.
data_description.omer_count_type: Choose between Traditional Aramaic or Modern Hebrew text for Omer counting.

error.missing_location: Location information is required for accurate calculations
error.invalid_latitude: Latitude must be between -90 and 90 degrees
error.invalid_longitude: Longitude must be between -180 and 180 degrees
error.invalid_havdalah_minutes: Havdalah minutes must be between 1 and 120
error.invalid_time_before: Time before check must be between 0 and 60 minutes
error.invalid_time_after: Time after check must be between 0 and 60 minutes
error.invalid_input: Invalid input provided, please check your entries
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Hebcal API

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one instance of Hebcal is allowed
